newsitem.title: CANADA: Methanex files for share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Methanex files for share buyback.

text.p: Methanex Corp said on Thursday its board has approved the repurchase of up to 14 million common shares, or not more than 10 percent of the company's public float.
Methanex said the decision follows a review of its financial capability and near-term cash requirements.
"Methanex's cash flow over the last three quarters has exceeded our previous expectations," Pierre Choquette, president and chief executive said in a statement.

"Current liquidity allows us to undertake a share repurchase without impairing our announced capital programs; we also have adequate reserves to continue to explore new opportunities to enhance our global position in methanol."

The normal course issuer bid will begin on April 7 and end on the earlier of April 6, 1998 and the date upon which Methanex has acquired the maximum number of shares allowed under the program or otherwise decided not to make further purchases.

Methanex said it has not bought any of its common shares in the last 12 months. The purchase program will be made under a normal course issuer bid through the facilities of the Toronto Stock Exchange.
